table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
	itemremarks=item.remarks,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2, 
	custphone=customer.phone,
	custsalestaxregno=customer.salestaxregno,
	custntn=customer.ntnno,   
	custdayslimit=customer.dayslimit,
	CustomerSite = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.issueheader.CustSiteCode),
	CustomerSiteAddress1 = (SELECT P.Address1 FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.issueheader.CustSiteCode),
	CustomerSitePhone = (SELECT P.Phone FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = dbo.issueheader.CustSiteCode),
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.issueheader.headerno,   
	headerinvno = dbo.issueheader.headerinvno,   
	date = dbo.issueheader.date,   
	invdiscperc = 0.00,   
	misccharges = 0.00,   
	flatdisc = 0.00,   
	invsalestax = 0.00,   
	gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
	icode = issuedetail.icode,   
	batch = issuedetail.batch,   
	expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = issuedetail.qty,   
	bonusqty = 0.0000,   
	packunits= issuedetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= issuedetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = 0.00,  
	itemflatdisc=0.00,   
	Id = issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=issueheader.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = 0.00,   
	gstperc = 0.00,   
	invgstperc = 0.00,   
	dbo.issueheader.referenceno,	
	dbo.issueheader.referencedate,	
	dbo.issueheader.refno2,	
	dbo.issueheader.remarks,

	printwaranty='N',
	printbatch='Y',
	reprintcount=0,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.issueheader.Acccode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=issueheader.smancode),
	amtreconinv=0.00
FROM 
	issueheader,   
	issuedetail,
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_Code ) AND  
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.issueheader.Acccode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
ORDER BY 
	issuedetail.issueinvcode,
	issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)
